title: E.coli Dilution mixed with standard HeLa  measured in DIA and DDA mode with timsTOF
projectDescription: E.coli Dilution were performed and mixed with standard HeLa in 1:1, 1:2, 1:4, 1:5 and 1:10 HeLa. These samples were measured both in DIA and DDA mode using timsTOF-pro-2 instrument. .
sampleProcessingProtocol: Mass spectrometry (MS) analysis was performed by the Proteomics and Modomics Experimental Core Facility (PROMEC), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU). The synaptosome samples were resuspended in 100 µL 1% sodium deoxycholate, 100 mM Tris-hydrochloride (pH 8.5), 10 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine, and 40 mM Chloroacetamide. The samples were sonicated 10 cycles of 30 s on and 30 s off, using the Bioruptor Pico sonicator (B01080010, Hologic Diagenode). Next, the samples were heated for 30 minutes at 95°C, before adding 100 µL 0.01 M ammonium bicarbonate and 0.5 µg trypsin for digestion overnight at 37°C. Peptides were desalted using C18 spin columns, and dried in a SpeedVac vacuum concentrator centrifuge (Thermo Fisher). The peptides were resuspended in 0.1% formic acid before performing liquid chromatography with tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) using a timsTOF Pro with the nanoE-lute liquid chromatography system (both from Bruker Daltonics). The peptides were separated for 75 minutes using a 150 µm*25 cm Pepsep 25 (Bruker Daltonics) with running buffers (A) 0.1% formic acid and (B) 0.1% formic acid in acetonitrile with a gradient of 2 - 40%. The timsTOF Pro was operated in the DIA PASEF mode. Source conditions were as follows: capillary voltage, 1,600 V; dry gas, 3.0 L/min; dry temperature, 180 °C. MS1 and MS2 spectra were acquired within an m/z range of 100–1,700, with collision energy linearly interpolated between 59 eV (1/K₀ = 1.60 V·s/cm²) and 20 eV (1/K₀ = 0.6 V·s/cm²).
dataProcessingProtocol: The DIANN (ref: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-022-31492-0) academic version 2.2 (https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN/releases/download/2.0/DIA-NN-2.3.1-Academia.msi) was used for processing raw mass-spectrometry data from timsTOF-pro 2 instrument. Along with defaults, oxidation of methionine and acetylation of protein N-terminal and deamidation of Aspargine and Glutamnine as dynamic post-translational modification was appended. Both the MS and MS/MS mass-accuracy was set to 20 PPM. Search was performed against the library that is generated with Human proteome consisting of one protein sequence per gene downloaded from Uniprot (Human https://www.uniprot.org/proteomes/UP000005640 E.coli https://www.uniprot.org/proteomes/UP000000625) in December 2025 along with DIANN’s internal contaminants database. More details along with step-by-step command line is provided in https://fuzzylife.substack.com/p/dia-nn-learned-to-search-dda post.
